Bank Analyst Quick Guide

1. Inspect Suspicious Nodes
Click any account circle on the network graph. Red nodes represent accounts with flagged anomaly scores (e.g. structuring transfers or rapid velocity spikes).
2. Review NVIDIA Nemotron AI Forensics
Click Investigate to generate a real-time forensic report examining structuring patterns, red flags, and risk severity.
3. Run "Predict Future Risks"
Click the purple Predict Future Risks button. The AI analyzes graph topology to identify which peripheral accounts are in danger of being used next as cash-out mules or layering stops.
4. Choose YES or NO
Under Analyst Decision Required, select YES to approve the AI's recommendation (freezing the account and filing a SAR), or NO to dismiss the alert as legitimate activity.

Experimental Design (3-Phase Evaluation)
To rigorously test whether FraudGraph anticipates emerging fraud, future transactions (T > 10:00 AM) are strictly masked during prediction. Nemotron evaluates the early graph (T ≤ 09:45 AM), and its predictions are scored against the ground-truth labels after the future is revealed.
